facts.fact: ANEC's steering data at 13 July 2026 show 471 of 629 civil-status centres digitalised with the LGEC, 75%, and 158 centres, 25%, still to digitalise; the article adds that digitalisation cannot be judged by centres equipped alone, regular data entry also counting.

facts.fact: At 13 July 2026 the national system counted 15,352,830 acts centralised in the Registre national de l'état civil (RNEC), which the article describes as centralising the civil-status data alongside the LGEC used in the centres; it does not say how many of those acts were entered at registration.

facts.fact: The Agence nationale de l'état civil (ANEC) carries the national remediation that deploys the LGEC in civil-status centres, with 3,695 agents and officers trained as at 13 July 2026.

facts.fact: A national remediation plan for the digitalisation of civil-status centres, run by ANEC, sets the LGEC deployment by region: Kaolack from 10 to 20 August 2026, then Kaffrine and Tambacounda, and the south in the fourth quarter of 2026.
